s: Shello leekol achar akilat apiqoman ubo v' seipim: achar akilat apiqoman asur leekol shum maakal baolam, chutz mimmatztza shemura mishsheat qetzira o mishsheat lisha, kede shello yaabor mippiv taam matztza shemura shel haapiqoman al yede taam oto maakal, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"z. Abal muttar lishtot kol hammashqin sheenan meshakkerin (abal mashqin hamshakkerin asur lishtot, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tp"a), lepi shettaam hashshetiyya eno maabir et taam haakila mippiv. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shettaam kol hammashqin mebattel mippiv et taam matztza shemura shel apiqoman, chutz mimmayim vekayyotze bahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tp"a. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem, im lo letzorek gadol:

Lo yokal haapiqoman bishne meqomot. Vaapillu becheder echad lo yoklennu beb' shulchanot, miqtzato beshulchan zeh umiqtzato beshulchan zeh, lepi shehaapiqoman hu zeker lappesach, veasur leekol min happesach bishne meqomot, shenneemar "bebayit echad yeakel":

Mi sheyyashan beemtza akilat haapiqoman veneor mishshenato — asur lo lachazor veleekol od min haapiqoman apillu lo akal adayin kezayit, lepi shehashshena chashuba hepseq ben akila laakila, ukesheokel achar hashshena — hare hu keokel bemaqom acher shello bammaqom harishon, veasur leekol haapiqoman bishne meqomot:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmeseb bilbad, abal bene hachabura hamsubbin veyashenu miqtzatan beemtza akilat haapiqoman veneoru — yekolin lachazor veleekol od apillu akelu kebar kezayit, sheen shenatam chashuba hepseq, kevan shemmiqtzat chaburatam nisharu belo shena. Abal im yashenu kol bene hachabura veneoru — enan chozerin leekol od:

Vekol zeh keshennirdemu beshena, abal im nitnamnemu bilbad veneoru, veken yachid shemmeseb venitnamnem veneor — yekolin lachazor veleekol. Veezehu mitnamnem? Yashen veeno yashen, neor veeno neor, kegon sheim qorin oto vehu oneh, veeno yodea lehashib dabar shetztzarik leharher qodem sheyyashib, ukeshemmazkirin oto hu nizkar, kegon sheshshoalin oto: beezeh maqom hinnachta chepetz peloni? Veeno yodea leharher velizkor beodo mitnamnem beezeh maqom hinnicho, ukeshemmazkirin oto veomerim lo: hinnachta bemaqom peloni — hu nizkar, veomer: hen o lav, vekayyotze bazeh:

Vekol zeh kesheyyashan leachar shehitchil leekol haapiqoman, abal im yashan qodem laken veneor — yakol lachazor veleekol kamma sheyyirtzeh veleekol haapiqoman achar kak. Veken yakol leekol seudato babbayit velelek leekol haapiqoman bebayit acher:
